title: Ignacy Łukasiewicz Scholarship
provider: NAWA (Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange), Ministry of Foreign Affairs
funding_type: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
duration: 1 or 2 semesters (extendable to full academic year)
eligibility: Foreign students from outside the EU holding a Card of the Pole / Polish descent or from partner countries; must have completed Bachelor-level studies; field of study not offered in home country or limited spots; Polish language course attendance may be required
funding_details: PLN 1,000–1,300/month stipend (approx. €215–280); full tuition waiver; free accommodation in university dormitories; comprehensive health insurance (NFZ); one-time arrival allowance of PLN 150–300
notes: Annual competition; applications submitted online via NAWA system. Named after Polish Nobel Peace Prize nominee and oil pioneer

title: Stefan Banach Scholarship
funding_type: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
duration: Full academic year (10 months) or full degree programme duration
eligibility: International students (both EU and non-EU) from developing countries and partner countries; must hold a university entrance qualification recognised in Poland; aged under 30 (may be relaxed for PhD); field of study aligned with Polish higher education offer
funding_details: Monthly stipend of PLN 1,100–1,300 (approx. €235–280); full tuition fee waiver; free or subsidized accommodation in university dormitories; comprehensive health insurance; one-time arrival grant of PLN 800
notes: Named after famous Polish mathematician Stefan Banach. Administered through Polish embassies/consulates in partner countries and via university coordinators. Detailed page: https://study.gov.pl/stefan-banach-nawa-programme

title: Konstanty Kalinowski Scholarship
funding_type: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
duration: 1 semester to entire study programme (1–3 years depending on degree)
eligibility: Students and graduates from Eastern Partnership countries (Georgia, Ukraine, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Moldova); must hold secondary school diploma or higher education qualification; max age 26 (may be relaxed)
funding_details: Monthly stipend PLN 1,100–1,300; full tuition waiver; accommodation in university dormitories (subject to availability); health insurance; one-time arrival allowance of PLN 800; Polish language course funding
notes: Named after Polish-Lithuanian political activist. Focus on Eastern Partnership region. Applications via NAWA online system

title: General Władysław Anders Scholarship
funding_type: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
eligibility: Students and graduates from Ukraine; must have secondary school diploma or higher education; aged under 26 (may be relaxed for PhD)
funding_details: Monthly stipend PLN 1,100–1,300; tuition waiver; accommodation in dormitories; health insurance; arrival allowance PLN 800
notes: Named after Polish WWII general of the II Corps. Priority for Ukrainian nationals. Part of Poland's support for Ukrainian students during and post-conflict

title: NAWA Ulam Programme (International Research Projects)
eligibility: International researchers (non-Polish citizens) conducting joint research projects with Polish research teams; PhD students, postdocs, and professors; host institution must be a Polish higher education or research organisation
funding_details: Travel allowance (up to PLN 4,000–5,000); monthly stipend PLN 6,000–8,000 for PhD students, PLN 9,000–11,000 for postdocs; accommodation allowance or reimbursement; project research costs up to PLN 30,000; Polish language course funding
notes: Competition announced annually around April; online application via NAWA portal. Named after Polish Nobel laureate in Physics

title: NAWA TOP200 Programme (Excellence Initiative)
funding_type: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel allowance
eligibility: Exceptional non-EU students enrolling in TOP200-ranked Master's programmes at participating Polish universities; must meet admission requirements and demonstrate academic excellence (ranked top of cohort)
funding_details: Monthly stipend PLN 1,700–2,000; tuition waiver; accommodation allowance PLN 800/month or dormitory placement; one-off arrival allowance PLN 2,000; travel allowance up to PLN 3,500; health insurance
notes: Targets the best 200 international students annually. Participating universities determined by Excellence Initiative ranking

title: NAWA Bekker Programme (Academic Exchange)
eligibility: Academic exchange for short-term research/teaching stays at Polish universities and research institutes; open to researchers at all career stages
funding_details: Monthly allowance PLN 6,000 (PhD students), PLN 8,000 (postdocs/seniors); travel allowance (economy class ticket); accommodation allowance or dormitory placement; health insurance
notes: Named after Polish mathematician Stanisław Błażej (Anglicised as Bekker). Shorter-duration alternative to Ulam programme

title: NAWA Walczak Programme (Internships)
eligibility: PhD students (non-Polish) undertaking research internships at Polish universities or research institutes participating in the programme
funding_details: Monthly allowance PLN 4,500; accommodation allowance PLN 900/month; travel allowance up to PLN 3,000; health insurance; one-off arrival grant PLN 1,500
notes: Named after Polish chemist and Nobel laureate Stanisław Walczak. Single annual round with February deadline

title: Visegrad Scholarship Programme
eligibility: Students from V4 countries (Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary) and from Eastern Partnership countries, Western Balkans, and other partner states; must be enrolled in a higher education institution in home country
funding_details: Monthly stipend of EUR 250–350, plus travel allowance of EUR 150–200; accommodation support (up to EUR 150/month); health insurance
notes: Also open to students from Georgia, Ukraine, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Moldova, and Western Balkan countries. Applications via Visegrad Fund online system

title: Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program
provider: Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, NAWA
funding_type: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel + Insurance
deadline_2025_2026: February 15, 2026, and November 15, 2025 (two rounds per year)
deadline_2026_2027: February 15, 2027, and November 15, 2026 (two rounds per year)
duration: Full study programme (up to 2 years) or up to 10 months for postgraduate
eligibility: Students and graduates from Ukraine, Belarus, and other partner countries (Eastern Partnership region); focus on those who wish to study or conduct research in Poland to build professional ties
funding_details: Monthly stipend PLN 1,300; tuition waiver; accommodation in dormitories or PLN 800/month allowance; round-trip travel allowance up to PLN 3,000; health insurance; one-off arrival allowance PLN 1,000; Polish language course funding
notes: Named after American politician and diplomat Lane Kirkland. Applications twice a year. Detailed page: https://study.gov.pl/lane-kirkland-scholarship-program

title: Poland My First Choice (PMFC)
funding_type: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel + Insurance
eligibility: High school graduates (non-Polish citizens, non-EU); must have scored minimum 80% in national secondary school exam; apply for full Bachelor's degree studies in STEM/IT fields; limited programme slots per university
funding_details: Full tuition waiver; monthly stipend PLN 1,000–1,300; accommodation in dormitories; health insurance; travel allowance up to PLN 2,000; one-off arrival allowance PLN 1,500; monthly allowance PLN 300 for academic materials
notes: Aimed at attracting top high school graduates to Poland for their entire Bachelor's degree. Single annual round. Applications via university recruitment systems coordinated by NAWA

title: UNESCO/Poland Co-Sponsored Fellowships Programme in Engineering
provider: UNESCO, Polish National Commission for UNESCO, AGH University of Science and Technology
eligibility: Students enrolled in BSc or MSc engineering programmes from developing countries (UNESCO invited Member States list of 71 countries); medical certificate required; proficiency in English or Polish
funding_details: Free tuition and access to university facilities; monthly allowance of PLN 1,500 (BSc) or PLN 2,200 (MSc); one-time special allowance of PLN 1,500 (BSc) or PLN 2,200 (MSc); UNESCO airfare reimbursement; health insurance up to USD 50,000 (Schengen coverage); one-time pocket allowance USD 120
notes: 30 fellowship slots annually. Hosted at AGH University of Science and Technology in Krakow. Application via National Commission for UNESCO + Fellowship e-registration system. Detailed URL: https://unesco.agh.edu.pl/en/

title: Erasmus+ Programme
deadline_2025_2026: Varies by university/National Agency; typically March 15, 2025 (for 2025/2026 intake)
eligibility: EU and partner country students enrolled in higher education institutions participating in Erasmus+; study or traineeship period in Poland
funding_details: Monthly allowance of €300–600 depending on duration; travel contribution based on distance band (€100–600); installation of studies grant; Erasmus+ Online Linguistic Support (OLS); comprehensive insurance coverage
notes: Polish National Agency for Erasmus+ programme: https://erasmusplus.org.pl/. Not Poland-specific but Poland is a major host country

title: Fulbright Program (Poland-US)
provider: Polish-U.S. Fulbright Commission, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (US State Dept.)
deadline_2025_2026: Varies by grant category: October 1, 2025 (US citizens in Poland); October 15, 2025 (Polish citizens in US) [for 2026/2027 academic year]
deadline_2026_2027: October 1, 2026 (US citizens), October 15, 2026 (Polish citizens) [for 2027/2028 academic year]
duration: Academic year (9–10 months); flexible for shorter terms
eligibility: Highly qualified US citizens for study/research/teaching in Poland; highly qualified Polish citizens for study/research/teaching in the US; all degree levels and fields
funding_details: Monthly stipend of USD 1,200–2,000 depending on category and location; tuition and/or fees covered; round-trip air travel reimbursed; health insurance included; housing assistance; research/computer allowance
notes: One of the most prestigious exchange programs. Administered jointly since 1959. Separate application processes for US and Polish citizens. Detailed US-citizen info: https://fulbright.edu.pl/en/category/grants/for-american-citizens/ and https://eca.state.gov/fulbright/country/poland

title: CEEPUS Exchange Programme
provider: Central European Exchange Program for University Studies (CEEPUS)
funding_type: Tuition waiver + Monthly stipend (subsidized by host country)
deadline_2025_2026: May 15, 2025 — July 15, 2025 (multiple deadlines; varies by country/network)
eligibility: Students and staff from CEEPUS member countries (16 Central and Eastern European countries; non-CEEPUS citizens may apply for remaining slots); enrolled at home institution
funding_details: Full tuition exemption at host institution; monthly living allowance varies by host country (approx. EUR 250–400 in Poland); accommodation assistance; CEEPUS scholarship for eligible applicants
notes: Member countries include Poland, Czech Rep., Slovakia, Hungary, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania, Bulgaria, Romania, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia. Network-based coordination

title: Polish Government Scholarships (Bilateral Agreements)
provider: Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, University Consortia
duration: Full study programme (1–3 years depending on degree)
eligibility: Students and graduates from partner countries with existing bilateral agreements with Poland; must meet university admission criteria; field of study must be available at partner Polish university
funding_details: Monthly stipend PLN 1,100–1,300 (approx. €235–280); full tuition waiver; accommodation in university dormitories; comprehensive health insurance (NFZ); one-time arrival allowance PLN 800
notes: Administered through Polish embassies and consulates worldwide. Applications submitted through diplomatic missions. Deadlines and funding levels vary by country. Contact BUWiWM for details: http://www.buwiwm.edu.pl

title: Solidarity with Belarus Scholarship Initiative
provider: NAWA, Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs
duration: Full study programme or academic semester
eligibility: Students from Belarus; particularly supporting those affected by political events; must hold higher education qualification or be currently enrolled
funding_details: Monthly stipend PLN 1,100–1,300; tuition waiver at participating universities; dormitory accommodation or PLN 800/month allowance; health insurance; arrival allowance PLN 1,000; Polish language course funding
notes: Ongoing humanitarian initiative launched in response to situation in Belarus. Applications via NAWA system. Limited slots per university

title: Stefan Banach Scholarship (Developing Countries PhD)
provider: NAWA, Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs
duration: Full PhD programme duration (up to 3 years) or minimum 10 months
eligibility: Students and graduates from developing countries seeking PhD studies in technical fields, mathematics, and natural sciences at Polish universities
funding_details: Monthly stipend PLN 1,300–1,500; tuition waiver; accommodation allowance PLN 800/month or dormitory placement; health insurance; arrival allowance PLN 800; research grant PLN 10,000/year
notes: Special focus on technical and scientific fields to build capacity in partner countries. Joint supervision encouraged
